mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachment_blobs(sha256,size_bytes,media_kind,media_type,created_at) VALUES(#{sha256},#{sizeBytes},#{mediaKind},#{mediaType},#{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT(sha256) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT a.attachment_id,a.workspace_id,a.blob_sha256,a.content_sha256,a.display_name,a.size_bytes, a.media_kind,a.media_type,a.status,a.created_at,a.expires_at,ma.message_id AS bound_message_id FROM attachments a LEFT JOIN message_attachments ma ON ma.attachment_id=a.attachment_id WHERE a.attachment_id=#{attachmentId}

SELECT a.attachment_id,a.workspace_id,a.blob_sha256,a.content_sha256,a.display_name,a.size_bytes, a.media_kind,a.media_type,a.status,a.created_at,a.expires_at,NULL AS bound_message_id FROM attachments a WHERE a.attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND a.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND a.status='DRAFT' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pending_input_attachments p WHERE p.attachment_id=a.attachment_id)

WITH RECURSIVE readable_threads(thread_id,workspace_id,depth) AS ( SELECT thread_id,workspace_id,0 FROM threads WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT l.parent_thread_id,r.workspace_id,r.depth+1 FROM readable_threads r JOIN thread_lineage l ON l.child_thread_id=r.thread_id JOIN task_context_seeds s ON s.context_seed_id=l.context_seed_id JOIN threads p ON p.thread_id=l.parent_thread_id AND p.workspace_id=r.workspace_id WHERE r.depth<4 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.task_kind='SIDE_TASK' AND s.inheritance_mode='EFFECTIVE_CONTEXT' AND s.parent_thread_id=l.parent_thread_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.references_json) ref WHERE json_extract(ref.value,'$.kind')='attachment' AND json_extract(ref.value,'$.attachmentId')=#{attachmentId}) ) SELECT a.attachment_id,a.workspace_id,a.blob_sha256,a.content_sha256,a.display_name,a.size_bytes, a.media_kind,a.media_type,a.status,a.created_at,a.expires_at,ma.message_id AS bound_message_id FROM attachments a LEFT JOIN message_attachments ma ON ma.attachment_id=a.attachment_id LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.message_id=ma.message_id LEFT JOIN pending_input_attachments pia ON pia.attachment_id=a.attachment_id LEFT JOIN pending_inputs pi ON pi.input_id=pia.input_id AND pi.state='PENDING' WHERE a.attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND a.workspace_id IN (SELECT workspace_id FROM readable_threads WHERE thread_id=#{threadId}) AND ((a.status='BOUND' AND m.thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM readable_threads)) OR (a.status='DRAFT' AND pi.thread_id=#{threadId}))
mapper.update: UPDATE attachments SET status='DISCARDED',discarded_at=#{discardedAt},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND status='DRAFT' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pending_input_attachments p WHERE p.attachment_id=#{attachmentId})

UPDATE attachments SET status='BOUND',bound_at=#{boundAt} WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND status='DRAFT' AND expires_at>#{boundAt} AND blob_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pending_input_attachments p WHERE p.attachment_id=attachments.attachment_id)
mapper.select: SELECT input_id FROM pending_input_attachments WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE attachments SET status='DISCARDED',discarded_at=#{discardedAt},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND status='DRAFT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pending_input_attachments p WHERE p.input_id=#{inputId} AND p.attachment_id=attachments.attachment_id)

UPDATE attachments SET status='DISCARDED',discarded_at=#{discardedAt},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE status='DRAFT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pending_input_attachments p WHERE p.input_id=#{inputId} AND p.attachment_id=attachments.attachment_id)

UPDATE attachments SET status='DISCARDED',discarded_at=#{discardedAt},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE status='DRAFT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pending_input_attachments p JOIN pending_inputs i ON i.input_id=p.input_id WHERE i.turn_id=#{turnId} AND i.state='PENDING' AND p.attachment_id=attachments.attachment_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pending_input_attachments WHERE input_id IN ( SELECT input_id FROM pending_inputs WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE attachments SET status='EXPIRED',expired_at=#{expiredAt},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE status='DRAFT' AND expires_at<=#{expiredAt} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pending_input_attachments p WHERE p.attachment_id=attachments.attachment_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM attachment_blobs WHERE sha256=#{sha256} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attachments a WHERE a.blob_sha256=#{sha256} AND a.status IN ('DRAFT','BOUND'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO thread_title_generations(generation_id,thread_id,turn_id,provider_id,model_id,config_generation,claimed_at) VALUES(#{generationId},#{threadId},#{turnId},#{providerId},#{modelId},#{configGeneration},#{claimedAt}) ON CONFLICT(thread_id) DO NOTHING
